program: Topstep standard 150K Trading Combine; no optional Daily Loss Limit add-on
assumptions: Apply the current rule/fee snapshot counterfactually to historical prices; historical rules may have differed.
Use the first available CME trading date of each specified calendar month; warm up indicators beforehand.
Each attempt starts fresh. Overlapping monthly attempts and OHLC paths are not independent probability samples.
Risk up to 1% of current nominal evaluation equity, including modeled costs; the 150-micro cap can reduce achieved risk.
The loss floor trails end-of-day cash, never falls, and locks at the initial balance; touch or breach on unrealized equity fails immediately.
Check passing at day end while flat: net profit >=9000 and >=best day/0.55, with at least two trading days.
Once flat and meeting profit/consistency/two-day requirements intraday, stop new entries pending end-of-day confirmation.
Flatten at 16:08 New York, two minutes before the listed regular cutoff. Earlier exchange closes retain a five-minute buffer.
Conservatively block all new orders at the listed routine news times every weekday: 08:25-08:35,13:55-14:05,14:25-14:35 New York. These do not overlap the strategy's entry sessions.
Emergency news/platform-specific temporary restrictions, qualitative conduct, broker approval and real fill quality are not certified by this model.
A gap across the required daily exit while a position is open censors the attempt; do not invent a fill or use a last-mark exit to declare a pass.
Subscription/reset/activation fees are external costs and are not deducted from the simulated trading P&L target.
A 90-calendar-day research horizon is not a Topstep time limit. Late data endings and unresolved attempts are censored, not counted as failures.
